allowed_interpretation: A phase PASS certifies only its registered finite-model operator/covariance on the canonical probes. Semantic particle-family roles, physical conjugate-state identity, calibrated electric charge, quantum spin, composite-particle identity, weak labels, and any second-U1 semantic quantity remain reveal-only hypotheses until independent source/dynamics gates exist.
alternative_hypothesis: H1: at least one preregistered dynamic operator survives its numerical and symmetry controls, while integrated closure is claimed only if every required independent operator sector closes.
assumptions: E011 v0.3.0 remains authoritative only for STATIC_READY topology/provenance. Canonical braid probes are generated finite-model representatives, not E011 dynamics-ready measurements.

All selected single-knot dynamic probes use one common closed-braid constructor before smoothing/resampling; the family test may not compare an analytic torus generator against a different twist-knot generator.
Global circulation reversal is an independent state sign. It is not assigned a physical semantic identity during blind analysis.
The period operator is only a mathematical line integral associated with a registered straight central core-vortex probe. No physical normalization or target value is supplied.
The three-component candidate contains one straight core vortex through each ring centre, each parallel to global +z and each with the same positive circulation sign.
The identity-braid three-component control uses the same braid scaffold length and core prescription as the candidate container.
A second U1-like observable and a doublet operator must be independently measured; neither may be manufactured from a desired closure equation.
Prior scientific FAIL/UNRESOLVED statuses never block later phase execution.

falsification_criteria.criterion: FAIL unless primary leave-one-out family accuracy is at least 6/7, exact label-permutation p <= 0.10, and the preregistered J_Fro family-contrast sign recurs across every resolution/core grid point.
FAIL unless the registered core period tracks the geometric winding within tolerance for every probe and the signed dynamic cross-response has stable sign across the registered numerical grid.
FAIL unless J(-Gamma)=-J(+Gamma) within 1e-10 and between-knot monodromy-fingerprint separation exceeds twice the registered within-knot numerical spread.
FAIL unless full-field velocity is odd and quadratic field energy is even under global circulation reversal within 1e-12.

FAIL unless the three-ring candidate has near-zero pairwise Gauss linking, each ring winds once about its own +z core, all three own-core periods are positive and near one, and candidate-vs-unlink dynamic contrast has recurrent sign and magnitude >= 0.005 across all registered probe scales.
UNRESOLVED unless an independent doublet operator and an independent second-U1-like operator exist; constructing either from a desired closure identity is forbidden.
Integrated closure PASS requires every registered required mechanism sector to PASS; FAIL/UNRESOLVED sectors remain visible and nonblocking for execution.

null_hypothesis: H0: the new dynamic observables are representation/construction artifacts, numerically unstable, universal kinematic identities, or insufficiently independent to support a multi-operator taxonomy.
objective: Upgrade A059 from static/operator screening to finite-core dynamic probes while preserving nonblocking execution, E011's STATIC_READY boundary, and semantic reveal separation. The period lane uses only closed-loop line-integral/residue mathematics; no physical interpretation is assumed by that mathematical construction.

steps.operation: P00/P01 verify E011 provenance and construct equal-method canonical braid probes.
P02 computes finite-core reduced Jacobians over resolution/core controls and performs exact-label-permutation family separation.
P03 computes integer-like periods and target-free signed dynamic-response cancellation rankings.
P04 tests knot-specific monodromy fingerprints and Gamma-reversal operator covariance.
P05 independently checks odd velocity/even quadratic energy under Gamma reversal.
P06 tests the three-ring, three-parallel-+z-core candidate against a matched identity-braid unlink control.
P08 refuses closure without independently derived doublet and second-U1 operators.
P07 retains a separate analytic parity-odd background-selector diagnostic; it cannot close a physical mechanism without independently supplied dynamics-ready background evidence.
P09 aggregates all operator-sector statuses without allowing isolated PASS outcomes to imply integrated closure.
